He uses a combination of a crossover and a behind-the-back move to effectively 'shake' his defender before finishing with a layup. The video is set in a Life Time gym featuring a prominent Stephen Curry mural in the background. The main takeaway is a showcase of high-level ball-handling skills, referred to in basketball slang as 'bag work.'
